numeric_oracle: Heterogeneous exact spheres with K_i=4G_i/3 and equal fractions have P_i=Q_i at K=4G/3. The two self-consistency equations reduce to G^2=G1*G2=36: K=8,G=6 GPa, density=2600 kg/m3. Additional prolate and mixed-shape inverse-design analytic oracles are in r2-oracles.json.
limitations: Explicit phase densities, GPa->Pa conversion; exact spheres and prolates retained, with no equal-phase restriction.
Upstream iteration stops on bulk change only and caps at 3000. Adapter checks BOTH weighted residuals <=1e-8 times their phase modulus scale and rejects nonconvergence without altering the kernel.
Fractions must sum to 1 within 1e-12. No imputed densities; LGPL-3.0 dependency. R2 NOT TESTED.
